name: Streak
desc: CRM built into Gmail. Manage pipelines, boxes, tasks, comments, contacts and organizations from your flows.

actions.name: create_box
actions.description: Create a new box (record) in a pipeline.

actions.name: update_box
actions.description: Update the name, notes, stage, assignees, or custom fields on an existing box.

actions.name: get_box
actions.description: Fetch a single box with its current stage, fields, and counts.

actions.name: find_box
actions.description: Search boxes by name or query. Returns matching boxes across all pipelines, optionally filtered to one pipeline.

actions.name: create_stage
actions.description: Add a new stage (column) to a pipeline.

actions.name: create_task
actions.description: Create a new task on a box.

actions.name: create_comment
actions.description: Add a comment to a box.

actions.name: create_contact
actions.description: Create a contact in a team. If a contact with the same email already exists, return that contact instead of creating a duplicate.

actions.name: create_organization
actions.description: Create an organization in a team. If an organization with the same domain already exists, return that organization instead of creating a duplicate.

actions.name: get_current_user
actions.description: Get the Streak user associated with the connected API key.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_box
triggers.description: Triggers when a new box is created in the selected pipeline.

triggers.name: updated_box
triggers.description: Triggers when a field on a box is updated in the selected pipeline.

triggers.name: box_stage_changed
triggers.description: Triggers when a box moves between stages in the selected pipeline.

triggers.name: box_pipeline_changed
triggers.description: Triggers when a box is moved out of (or into) the selected pipeline.

triggers.name: new_comment
triggers.description: Triggers when a comment is added to a box in the selected pipeline.

triggers.name: new_task
triggers.description: Triggers when a task is created on a box in the selected pipeline.

triggers.name: task_completed
triggers.description: Triggers when a task on a box in the selected pipeline is marked complete.

triggers.name: task_due
triggers.description: Triggers when a task becomes due (but has not yet been completed) on a box in the selected pipeline.

triggers.name: new_meeting_or_call_log
triggers.description: Triggers when a meeting note or call log is created on a box in the selected pipeline.

triggers.name: new_contact
triggers.description: Triggers when a new contact is created in the selected team.

triggers.name: updated_contact
triggers.description: Triggers when a contact in the selected team is updated.
